audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phases[N].side read "Diana" while content win[] read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei — all seven rows disagreed across layers, and the full-layer whys under those Diana rows described Hwei winning the stage.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches content win[] exactly, and 50.16% over 2193 games is an even matchup, not a lane Diana owns at every level. The kit reason is concrete: before 6 she needs Crescent Strike to land before Lunar Rush is free, and Hwei paints from outside 900 units.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side = Hwei, phases[3..4].side = Skill, phases[5..6].side = Hwei, with the two even rows and the two late rows rewritten so the sentence matches the verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[5] said item spikes scale both kits "evenly without flipping the lane" on a row the chart awards to Hwei. spikes[1] described Hwei's R as a "burst/root" — it is neither a root nor an interrupt.
audit.why: Hwei's R is 1300 range and slows; Moonfall is 475 range and pulls. The first-item row belongs to Hwei because his siege range is untouchable by a 475-unit ultimate.
audit.corrected: whys[5] now names the range reason; spikes[1] states both ultimates by range and gives Moonfall's 100s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was stated only as "Moonlight marks reset her dash", with no numbers and no consequence. spikes[0] called Crescent Strike a "melee-range Q"; `early` attributed "passive sustain" to Moonsilver Blade; Hwei's own tools were called "EE fear", "W root/charm" and a "root".
audit.why: Riot's text on Lunar Rush: "Lunar Rush has no cooldown when used to dash to an enemy afflicted with Moonlight." So dodging the 900-range Crescent Strike arc puts her only gap-closer back on 22s at rank 1 (14s at rank 5). Moonsilver Blade cleaves every third strike and grants attack speed after a spell — it heals nothing. Hwei's E sub-abilities are Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss / Crushing Maw (EQ/EW/EE); his W paints are Fleeting Current / Pool of Reflection / Stirring Lights — no root, no charm.
audit.corrected: Dodge the arc and Lunar Rush costs 22 seconds; stand Moonlit inside 825 units and it is free. Grim Visage (EQ) is the one answer and exists only for the dash landing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pale Cascade never appeared anywhere on the page, so the reader was told to burst a champion who carries a shield into every trade.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags shield-absorbs-burst: "Diana's Pale Cascade (W) absorbs your burst window — force it out before you commit." It is a 15s cooldown at rank 1 (9s at rank 5) and the shield is larger if the third sphere detonates.
audit.corrected: Pale Cascade now appears in winCon, dontsFull[2].d, loading and wants.you[3] with its cooldown and the force-it-out sequencing.

audit.whatIsWrong: 23 lint hits: Diana called "he/his/him" across tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead, two phases whys, breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading, three dos/donts titles and bodies, and seven report entries. dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, and breakdown.cooldowns had no digit.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields regendered; the eight non-report fields rewritten with kit-grounded content, report entries fixed with pronoun-only swaps.

notes: Chart: all seven full-layer sides read "Diana" against content win[] of Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei — the worst cross-layer disagreement in my slice, and the full-layer whys under those Diana rows were themselves Hwei-favoured, so the page contradicted itself three ways. Sides now match content and packet.levelChart; win[] needed no edit. Ratings left at 7/7/7/7/8/7/7 — I did not renumber them; diffRating 8/10 is about how punishing the matchup is to misplay, which survives an even level chart at a 50.16% win rate. The buried lede this page never stated: Lunar Rush has NO cooldown against a Moonlit target, so dodging the 900-range Crescent Strike arc is the difference between a free dash and a 22-second one. Pale Cascade was absent from the entire page despite being the shield that eats Hwei's burst window. Also corrected: Moonsilver Blade was described as "passive sustain" — it cleaves and grants attack speed, it does not heal. Did NOT assert whether Grim Visage can interrupt Moonfall's delay or whether Hwei's spells are blocked by anything Diana has: neither is in the kit text. Report entries were pronoun-swapped only, per the sweep exclusion.
